stem: A dog eats 1.25 cups of dog food twice a day. Which graph best represents this relationship?
visual_elements: Graph A: Line passing through points (0,0) to (4,5) labeled Dog Food Eaten, Number of Cups vs Number of Days
Graph B: Line passing through points (0,0) to (5,2.5) labeled Dog Food Eaten, Number of Cups vs Number of Days
Graph C: Line passing through points (0,0) to (2,5) labeled Dog Food Eaten, Number of Cups vs Number of Days
Graph D: Line passing through points (0,0) to (5,4.5) labeled Dog Food Eaten, Number of Cups vs Number of Days
notes: Answer choices are represented by labeled graphs. No additional text in answer choices.
